pinning.reason: The artifact was fetched from the pinned Hugging Face revision and its byte size and SHA-256 were recorded from those bytes. It was then executed through the LiteRT layer on this machine: class-order probes on the pinned artifact gave a horizontal line -> index 1 (0.9505), an axis-aligned rectangle -> index 3 (0.9534), a triangle -> index 5 (0.9528) and a circle -> index 4 (0.9514), confirming the 13-class order recorded in the qualification record.
